name: Mary Walcott
original_name: メアリ・ウォルコット
source:
"G-Geez, I didn't do it for you, idiot!"

A Wordsworth resident who initially treats [url=/c87471]Mai[/url] as an outsider, it is later revealed that her concern for Mai is mistaken for coldness. A tsundere by nature, she is aware of her tough image but is hoping to be more honest with herself and her feelings. She is often seen bickering playfully with [url=/c94033]Charlie[/url].

[From [url=https://ideafintl.com/death-request-2/chara/?page=mary]official page[/url]]
